text_block_list.text:
While out on a walk in town on my day off,
I bumped into Rulership.
Seeing her out and about was quite
rare...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Fancy meeting you here.
...What?
Even I step outside when circumstances demand
it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've finally finished running my errands
and was about to catch my breath—
Oh, that reminds me.
I have just the thing.
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's an invitation ticket to a quaint tearoom
nearby.
My father received it through a mutual
acquaintance,
and I was looking for a chance to use it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Care to join me, if you have time? Come now,
no need to be polite.
choice_data_list: Are you sure? Don't mind if I do, ...
Are you sure? Don't mind if I do, ...

text_block_list.text:
And with that,
I ended up having tea with Rulership.
Talk about an unexpected turn of events...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Phase One complete.
A flawlessly natural execution of guiding
them right where I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
you are already dancing in the palm of my
hand.
"Spending time together without any specific
agenda"... That in itself is the strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A purposeless, casual hangout,
yet deeply fulfilling.
...Today,
you shall receive that very "experience"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Once that happens,
Trainer will naturally desire to make time
like this. ...And before long,
it will become our "daily routine." That is
the master plan.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(First,
we break bread in a relaxed atmosphere to
stimulate engaging conversation.
Heheheh... The "luncheon technique" is simple,
yet deadly effective.)

—We arrived at a five-star hotel's
tearoom.
Exquisitely poured black tea,
a three-tiered stand...
It was the real deal.
choice_data_list: (Th-This place is so upscale...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well? Quite a relaxing space,
wouldn't you say?
My family has frequented this establishment
since I was a child.
choice_data_list: Y-You're really used to this... Whoa!
Y-You're really used to this... Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah—hey, are you alright?!
Ah... you merely spilled it.
You didn't burn yourself, did you?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I got a little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Eh? Nervous...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(What was there to be nervous about?
We were just having tea at a run-of-the-mill
café...
...Tsk,
no choice. Tactical adjustment required!)

After leaving the tearoom,
Rulership suggested dropping by an arcade.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
How about we try that rock-paper-scissors
game?
choice_data_list: A kids' game...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha,
an overly simplistic game of pure chance
isn't bad on occasion.
Oho, it says here it detects your hand
gesture via motion sensor.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Unpredictability strongly piques the curiosity
of others...
Which means it's time for "Operation Gap
Appeal"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I shall display a rare,
child-at-heart side that contrasts with my
usual "mature" demeanor.
It builds approachable rapport—
killing two birds with one stone.

She began playing with a carefree
demeanor.
Just as I was thinking how nice it was to
see her having fun like this...

text_block_list.name: Rock-Paper-Scissors ...
text_block_list.text:
"—Tie game, boing! Try agaaain!
Medals will double next rooound!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Another tie?! 
Preposterous. Statistically improbable.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Oho, I see. So that's how it plays.
Trainer,
this motion camera is remarkably
sophisticated.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It appears to predict my intended hand based
on finger extension in a split-second
window. Furthermore,
it calibrates the overall odds so the player
barely falls short of victory.
choice_data_list: I-It does that...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh...!
How foolish of me to underestimate a children's
machine!
However! Now that the mechanism is laid bare,
victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I shall execute a feint!
This ends on the next turn! Rock, paper,
scissors, shoot!!

And Rulership secured a flawless victory!
The triumphant look on her face was truly
that of a master of the board.
choice_data_list: Ahaha! That is so like you!
Fufufu! That is so like you!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Like me...?
Wait. Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(That means I just acted the same as
usual?!
Wait, where did the gap appeal goooo?!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: N-Next! Let us proceed to the next venue!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(What do I do?
I must turn the tables somehow.
Is there some field advantageous to me... Ugh,
there are so many people...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, honestly... Is this evening rush hour?
Damn it...! Walking through this is an utter...
nightmare...
choice_data_list: Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is... nothing... *wheeze*... *gasp*—
I'm sorry,
I really... can't take thiiiis...
choice_data_list: R-Ruler?!

text_block_list.text:
It seemed Rulership was completely overwhelmed
by the crowd.
I searched the map on my phone for a quiet
place where she could rest.
choice_data_list: Ah, this spot should work...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *Exhale*...
choice_data_list: Can you stand up alright now?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm okay... I'm calming down.
You saved me...
As expected of my right hand...

What a relief. There were few people here,
it was semi-sheltered,
and the fresh air seemed like just what she
needed to recover.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, this wasn't supposed to happen...!
We were supposed to have fun and say,
"Let's hang out again soon!"...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Brrr... It's gotten rather chilly.
Let's head inside. Uh... this way?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Whoa...! That's high...

Rulership gazed out at the nighttime cityscape
with wide-eyed wonder.
Perhaps she didn't come to places like this
very often.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Breathtaking... It's gorgeous.
Is this truly the same city we were just
walking through?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, reality has some incredible resolution,
doesn't it?
The volume of information utterly dwarfs
any bird's-eye map.
choice_data_list: It really is beautiful.
It really is beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I never would've come to a place
like this on my own in a million years...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Mmh... Wait. It went off-script,
but isn't the board state
actually looking solid? ...Yes! With this vibe,
I can totally...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, today was pretty fun.
...So, what's the plan for tomorrow?
choice_data_list: Tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather not go out on the town for a
while.
...Though,
stopping by the school cafeteria wouldn't
kill me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe come over to my lair for board
games?
I'll be there all day.
Just swing by whenever you're done
working.
choice_data_list: Huh? So you want to hang out tomor...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're just gonna say it out loud like
that?!
I-I mean, whatever, if you don't wanna,
that's fine...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Not even the "illusion of choice" technique
works on you...?
Ugh, how do you just pierce through like
that?)
choice_data_list: Sorry! Whichever one you prefer wo...

text_block_list.text:
When I said that,
a look of quiet relief washed over her
face. The sudden invite surprised me,
but my schedule was open after class
tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Let's chat a bunch tomorrow too.
Let's chat a bunch tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...!
*sigh*... You... Seriously,
you're impossible...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Well,
fine.
Today's moves will pay off in the next
phase.
Achievement unlocked, for now.)

After that... I walked Rulership back to
the academy dorms and parted ways for the
night.
choice_data_list: Well then, good night.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, see you tomorrow.
............

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Going out is usually nothing but a drag...
but, huh.
When I'm with them...
how should I put it...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, tactical maneuvers aside,
I can't deny it was a refreshing change of
pace. After all,
time like this is essential for building
rapport...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—We totally,
definitely need to do this way more
often!!
